multibossbar.command.error.invalidindex: The index %d is out of bounds.
multibossbar.command.help_command:
=== MultiBossBar Commands ===
/multibossbar create <name> <displayName>
/multibossbar remove <name>
/multibossbar list
/multibossbar show <name>
/multibossbar hide <name>
/multibossbar addbar <name> <barName>
/multibossbar removebar <name> <index>
/multibossbar setpercent <name> <barIndex> <percent>
/multibossbar setcolor <name> <barIndex> <color>
multibossbar.command.error.invalidcolorl: Invalid color %s. Valid colors: WHITE, ORANGE, MAGENTA, LIGHT_BLUE, YELLOW, LIME, PINK, GRAY, LIGHT_GRAY, CYAN, PURPLE, BLUE, BROWN, GREEN, RED, BLACK.
